question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the highlighted segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement’.
Come quickly __if you will__ catch the train.
solution:
The correct answer is '**If you want to**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The sentence uses the conditional structure, which requires correct verb usage to reflect the intended meaning. 
 
• The phrase "**Come quickly if you will catch the train**" is grammatically incorrect because "if" clauses typically do not use "will" unless expressing willingness. 
 
• "**If you want to**" appropriately conveys the sense of urgency and intention without grammatical error. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Come quickly if you want to catch the train."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "If you have"** is incorrect because it does not align with the context of urgency or intention. 
 
• **Option 2: "If you will have"** is incorrect as it introduces unnecessary complexity and is grammatically awkward. 
 
• **Option 4: No improvement** is incorrect because the original sentence is grammatically flawed.
